scope: Scripted golden evidence on these exact bytes, plus a hosted configured-judge run on an EARLIER candidate. No configured judge run exists for these bytes.

observations.name: Scripted golden checks on these exact task bytes: 3 gate, 43 Functional and 6 Polish criteria, app installed with solve.sh and launched as tests/test.sh launches it (uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH, NODE_PATH, cwd outside /app), one real process restart.
limitations: Fixtures are entered with a paste event; graded actions use real keys and mouse input.
Ran in the agent image, not through tests/test.sh in the verifier image.
Visual ratings are not measured by a judge for these bytes.

These results were produced on the bytes of the previous commit; the only difference since is one added paragraph in each of the five judge prompt.md files (check only, never fix), which no scripted test reads.

observations.name: Hosted portal run 1 on an EARLIER candidate (ZIP eda58464, QC input 4f93c627): Oracle reward 0.9833 (both gates pass, Functional 41/41, Polish 6/6, Visual 0.9167), nop 0, GPT-5.6 Luna 0 (render gate failed because Run never works in its app). Oracle trial wall time about 42 minutes including all judges.
limitations: That candidate differs from these bytes: since then the render gate was reduced to load-and-type, cw_basic_run_output was added, several criteria and public notes were reworded after two QC rounds (console placement, preview-isolation probes, document jump keys, restore replay, stale-save order), and the golden changed (layout CSS, toolbar markup, handler attributes allowed in the preview, focus moved to the code as soon as Save is pressed).
It is evidence that the configured judge can launch, grade and finish within its budgets on a near-identical task, not a measurement of these bytes.
No target-model score exists with the scored suites run.
